templates.name: General
templates.purpose: What any change is held to, whatever it is written in: a failure hidden, input trusted, a credential or personal data exposed, a resource left open, behaviour changed with nothing to prove it, work left unfinished.

templates.name: TypeScript
templates.purpose: Where a change makes the compiler prove less than the code assumes: a value declared or asserted past the type checker, a check silenced, a promise nobody waits for, a union or a lookup the code does not cover.
